entries.title: Proverbs 7:1
segments: ¶My son, keep my words, And treasure my commands within you.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:2
segments: Keep my commands and live, And my law as the apple of your eye.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:3
segments: Bind them on your fingers; Write them on the tablet of your heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:4
segments: Say to wisdom, "You [are] my sister," And call understanding [your] nearest kin,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:5
segments: That they may keep you from the immoral woman, From the seductress [who] flatters with her words.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:6
segments: ¶For at the window of my house I looked through my lattice,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:7
segments: And saw among the simple, I perceived among the youths, A young man devoid of understanding,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:8
segments: Passing along the street near her corner; And he took the path to her house

entries.title: Proverbs 7:9
segments: In the twilight, in the evening, In the black and dark night.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:10
segments: And there a woman met him, [With] the attire of a harlot, and a crafty heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:11
segments: She [was] loud and rebellious, Her feet would not stay at home.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:12
segments: At times [she was] outside, at times in the open square, Lurking at every corner.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:13
segments: So she caught him and kissed him; With an impudent face she said to him:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:14
segments: "[I have] peace offerings with me; Today I have paid my vows.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:15
segments: So I came out to meet you, Diligently to seek your face, And I have found you.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:16
segments: I have spread my bed with tapestry, Colored coverings of Egyptian linen.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:17
segments: I have perfumed my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:18
segments: Come, let us take our fill of love until morning; Let us delight ourselves with love.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:19
segments: For my husband [is] not at home; He has gone on a long journey;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:20
segments: He has taken a bag of money with him, [And] will come home on the appointed day."

entries.title: Proverbs 7:21
segments: With her enticing speech she caused him to yield, With her flattering lips she seduced him.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:22
segments: Immediately he went after her, as an ox goes to the slaughter, Or as a fool to the correction of the stocks,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:23
segments: Till an arrow struck his liver. As a bird hastens to the snare, He did not know it [would cost] his life.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:24
segments: ¶Now therefore, listen to me, [my] children; Pay attention to the words of my mouth:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:25
segments: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways, Do not stray into her paths;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:26
segments: For she has cast down many wounded, And all who were slain by her were strong [men].

entries.title: Proverbs 7:27
segments: Her house [is] the way to hell, Descending to the chambers of death.
